title: Helpless Idols, Remembering Allah, and True Believers

paragraphs.text: The false deities cannot help those who call on them. They cannot even help themselves. They are servants, just like the people who call on them. They have no feet to walk or hands to strike. They have no eyes to see or ears to hear. The Prophet says, "My protector is Allah, who sent down the Book." He is the ally of the righteous.

Accept what people give freely, order what is good, and turn away from the ignorant. If Satan whispers evil to you, seek refuge in Allah. Those who fear Allah remember Him and then see clearly. The Qur'an is light, guidance, and mercy. When it is recited, listen and pay attention. Remember your Lord within yourself, morning and evening, with humility. Those near your Lord are never too proud to worship Him.

People asked the Prophet about the spoils of war. The decision belongs to Allah and the Messenger. So fear Allah and make peace among yourselves. True believers feel fear in their hearts when Allah is mentioned. His verses increase their faith, and they rely on their Lord.

things taken from the enemy in war
